headline: Fake bank giveaway uses Vap Poya as bait
body: Sri Lanka CERT has urged the public not to be misled by a fraudulent social media message claiming that a leading bank in Sri Lanka is offering a special gift to mark Vap Poya Day, which falls on Sunday. According to Sri Lanka CERT, the bank has not announced or initiated any such gift offer. The circulating message is suspected to be a scam designed to steal personal information, banking credentials and other sensitive data. The organisation warned that individuals who fall victim to the scam could face the risk of having their bank accounts compromised. Sri Lanka CERT has advised the public not to click on any links attached to the message or provide personal or banking information through suspicious websites. The public is urged to verify promotional offers through official bank channels and remain vigilant against online scams.

headline: SLCERT warns of fake bank reward scam ahead of Vap Poya
body: News Published on By Share Tweet The Sri Lanka Computer Emergency Readiness Team (SLCERT) has warned the public about a fraudulent social media message claiming that a leading Sri Lankan bank is offering special rewards to mark Vap Poya Day. In a statement, SLCERT said the message, circulating on social media, falsely claims that the bank is offering a special gift to mark Vap Poya Day, which falls on Sunday (25). The organisation confirmed that the bank concerned has not introduced, or announced, any such reward scheme. SLCERT said the message was believed to be part of a scam aimed at obtaining personal information, banking credentials and other sensitive data from unsuspecting victims. It warned that individuals who provide such information could also risk having their bank accounts compromised. SLCERT urged the public not to click on links accompanying such messages or provide personal or banking information in response to unsolicited offers. It also advised the public to remain vigilant and verify promotional offers directly with the relevant bank before responding to them.
